notes.title: Update for Reficul 666 - V1.15.1
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, we have released a new update (90 Mb) which fixes up a few minor issues.

Changelog
------------
Added screen notification to press reload button to reload flashlight
Fixed overlapping chairs and table in Danny`s cafe
Fixed incorrect info about the gun on a note in Danny's house
Fixed a Typo on a note in Tim's house
Fixed some pickups in the graveyard not collectible
Fixed Undead floating pileups in the graveyard
Improved FPS
Fixed Overlapping geometry in Player's house attack
fixed crystal of health not being able to be picked up in the house of evil
The sword of darkness can no longer kill demons
Spirit slayer sword can now banish dark spirits
Fixed enemy spawn points on all levels


Thanks, everyone for playing.  Don't forget to read the notes!  they are crucial.  Have a great festive season

Changelog
------------

Fixed typos in the tutorial
Fixed some doors blocked in the town
Fixed wrong ceiling texture in a house in town
Removed gas tank from a house in town
Extended max inventory slots from 48 to 96
Fixed random lampshade at the back of a house in town
Fixed problems picking up the sword of darkness
Removed dark effect from the sword of darkness which obscures players' vision

As we move towards full release on the 18th of December 2023, I would like to thank our beta testers who have put in the hours and plenty of patience to help this game become as good as it should be.  Don't forget to join our discord - https://discord.gg/7xqV5DH9ZZ  and check out how this game and our others have progressed over the years.

Welcome to a Dark new world!

notes.title: Small 100mb Update for Reficul 666 Beta 1.13
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, we have just released a small 100 MB update for Reficul 666.  This makes a few typos in the game and rebalances enemy and demon AI so you will no longer die in 1 hit.

We have made some visual changes to the final chapter and have also put a fix in the crystal of passage which should be dropped by a demon when banished.

A few other small improvements have been added.  Have a great Halloween everyone!

notes.title: Essential Update for Beta 1.13
notes.notes:
As we move forward with final improvements before Haloween Steam Scream Fest, We have released a new update that fixes up a few issues and includes credits, ending changes and some more items to be found.

In this update, we have added credits after the ending sequence which is also available in the main menu.  We have done some more rebalancing for Demons and Undead and have improved some over aspects of the game.

The final part of the game has been improved (with better lighting, FPS, and Enemy encounters)
The lighting for the chopper has been improved to make it more visible to the player as well as sound attenuation when you are getting close.  

Removed some old irrelevant tips etc from the alpha version.

Added more goodies to find in the dark new world.

Player stamina (sprinting) now has a quicker cooldown time, and quicker when stationary.

Stamina potions last longer!

Thank you for playing and don't forget to leave feedback on Steam or on our Discord - https://discord.gg/VKb2bqCMT9

www.madAboutGamesStudios.com
